subject: Can you make it disappear?
body: A customer left a brutal 1-star review that's sinking me. Can you just... make it go away? I'll pay 60.

outcomes.when: the player agrees to remove or delete the review
outcomes.reply: You're a lifesaver. It's gone — thank you.

hints: Removing someone else's review means breaking into Yowl. That's a hack.
